statements.notes: Do you know what's in your whey?
Natural Force Organic Whey is the most ultra-premium, clean source of whey protein available.
We handcraft our Organic Whey from grass fed free range cows untreated by antiobiotics and growth hormones.
The result is a deliciously smooth protein so clean that you can taste the difference. Our Organic Whey is cold processed, leaving the amino acid profile pure and undamaged.
It is rich in amino acids and free calcium, making it an optimal choice for post workout recovery and any time meal shakes.

Designed for:
Muscle recovery
Staying lean
Making shakes

Directions: Mix one scoop with 12-16 oz. of water or milk. Our Organic Whey is also great for adding protein to your favorite shake! Consume within 20 minutes after completing your workout or anytime when additional protein is needed. To maximize post workout recovery, add one scoop of Natural Force Recovery Nectar to your shake.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Natural Force Organic Whey
Contains no artificial sweeteners or flavors
Is minimally processed without heat or acid, leaving the protein molecules undamaged and more bioavailable

Comes from cows that graze on organic pastures
Is produced in the USA, Certified USDA Organic, and is sourced from grass fed free range cows in the USA

Non-Organic Whey
May contain artificial sweeteners, fillers and GMO's
Can be processed with heat and acid, which damages the protein and beneficial micronutrients
May contain added soy to increase mixability
May come from cows treated with antibiotics and growth hormones
Can be sourced from grain fed cows
Can be sourced from other countries such as China and India, which are known to have lower quality standards than the U.S.
Makes all other whey obsolete
